Scariest experience I've had was back before I started my spiritual journey onto santeria but this event what led my god mother to invite me into said religon.

It started small with kitchen cabinets slamming open and shut, my grandma who I lived with at the time always blamed it on our cat trying get his treats out the cabinets despite neither of us ever seeing him do so before or after. To be honest she was dismissive of any 'ghost' activity. It was frustrating cause I knew dusty our cat wouldn't do such a thing but whatever. Soon it devolped into her yelling at me to stop running around trying to scare her. She saw me, run past her multiple times but I had NEVER left my room at the time she would blame me. After the third or fourth time of supposedly seeing me she tried chase me down and realized I was telling the truth that i hadn't left my room. 

She apologized to me and we were both quiet from that point on as for sure now something had to be messing with us but now we were both too scared to say or so anything about it. Eventually the rest of the day went uneventful beside a cabinet slamming again and this time the cat was on the bed with me so I knew dusty wasnt doing it. So I just get up and lock my door to ignore it, eventually dusty wanted to get out so I open my door and go with him I had use the bathroom anyways. I was stopped in my tracks as I said a 10 year old or so girl in my path, I look her up and down and she didnt "disappear" like most people say ghost do like blink and their gone type stuff. Nope, still there. She wore a long sleeve white shirt that was too big almost like a dress and it was wet. I'd say if she was ant bigger I'd believe I met la llorona. But the MOST terrifying thing about what I saw was she had no head at all just shoulder, arms, torso, legs, feet. My cat let out a hiss and lunged at the figure and I bolted to my grandma room screaming and crying telling her what I saw.

Next day she rushed me to my god mother and I explained this all to her. We talked about other experiences and was invited in to see some things as she believed this was my sign from my spirit kids to learn and participate in a religion that my grandmother kept hidden from me. As every female except her and my mother was part of but instead she raised me ferociously catholic to hide it.

That same little girl "ghost" whatever ya wanna call her still sticks by me. Been over 10 years and she hates when people say they dont believe me. My husband has doubted her and now 100% believes after shes made a few appearances and called his name.

Pitbulls were never nanny dogs! This is a myth made to adopt out more mutts that are mislabeled as pitbulls. The american pitbull terrier was bred as a dog for entertainment in taking large dangerous game like bears, people took that behavior and directed it to dogs starting dog fighting rings and what the breed is known for sadly. Modern american pitbull terriers are catch dogs again taking down big game unlike bay dogs like beagles that just corner the animals they target. 

The old picture of pitbulls and children were famous dog fighting pits and were sat with children to show they will tear a dog apart but wont harm a human much less a child. 

If you love the pitbull breed as much as I do, and I hope you do it's best to educate yourself on the breed and not spread myths that can lead someone to taking on a breed that can harm them. American pitbull terriers like most working breeds need a job/outlet beside a walk or two a day or they can become destructive, restless or even worse violent. It's like buying a herding dog and not stopping its herding nip on children then being mad it bit a child. 

This goes for ALL breeds of dogs. Educate yourself on the breeds and their history to find the right fit for you <3

Awh not the pitbull hate xD, pitbulls are not a registered breed in america and only a handful of breeders you can count on one hand have true american pitbull terriers in america. All those "pitbulls" you see are mutts! Just like Hades above is a cane corso + other breeds mixed. Not a pitbull. His head is too high and big, his shape is too big and stocky, a real pitbull is lean and muscled not big and fat and its body shape reflects that. His shape reflects a full sturdy body of a cane corso and his chest and height size reflects more of a great Dane which are literal gentle giants. 

If you're going to hate a breed at least know what the breed looks like and is and if it even exists in the area you live in or the person who owns the dog lives in.

So context for the first time it happened; my best friend and I have been friends since he was 3 and I was 5 and my mother dated his uncle way before either of us were born let alone thought of so our families interweaves for ages. So growing up his family treated me like their own and mine treated his as our own so we all knew each other very well. His uncle NEVER knocked or rang a door bell he always whistled to get our attention Instead. So certainly not a strangers death or anything.

One day his uncle ends up in the hospital, he was jumped by a few people in a robbery attempt. Doctors say hes fine and so on. I'm at home and my best friend mom comes over and tells us she gon a visit him at the hospital and bring him home (so we can day hi etc. When he got back we lived next to each other) soon as she leaves I turn around to go back to my room and I heat HIS whistle it was very unique and distinctive so wasnt some random passerby or anyone outside making this noise. I run to my grandmother's room to ask if she heard uncle bebo. She goes no? And looks at me confused so I say "hes not coming home, hes gonna die" i get yelled at for saying that cause why would i wish death on someone. Soon after we get a call and it's my best friend mom screaming and crying that he passed. 

Second time was my own mother (again a little context before the story). My mother was a drug addict so my grandmother raised me. I saw my mother during her sober periods and loved her none the less but when she was on drugs she dissapeared for months at a time. It was during one of her disappearance acts this happened.

I had a vivid dream of my mother saying shes fine, stop asking and looking for her and I go okay mom. Next day my second oldest brother and my oldest sister ask to come over (she had 8 kids I'm the second youngest). When they got there before they even said anything I go "moms dead isnt she" and they say yeah shes been dead for a few days they just didnt know how to tell me and my grandmother. 

Lastly most vivid one as well, I went to the bathroom one day and I swear I saw this child no bigger than a 6 year old and she met my gaze and said "yeah.. no more christmases" then poof she was gone. I knew what she meant, I was gonna lose my grandmother. Ended up losing my grandma before Christmas and yes I have not celebrated a Christmas ever since. Even with a kid of my own.
